_howto: Elections polled by the Delaware Department of Elections ENR adapter (server/src/adapters/deenr.js). The ENR page https://elections.delaware.gov/results/enr/{electionId}.html loads Election_StatewideResults_ID_{electionId}.json, Election_ByCountyWithWilmington_ID_{electionId}.json and Election_VoterTurnout_ID_{electionId}.json from the same folder. countyColumns = the county columns of the by-county file ('Wilmington' / 'Rest of New Castle' are parts of New Castle and are not used). The Socrata dataset data.delaware.gov yg7x-kgjc is NOT used: it carries the same statewide rows but its data_as_of was still 2026-09-29 on election night.
